text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("inbo/crbirding", fork = TRUE). Install development dependencies devtools::install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing. title: Transform CR-Birding data to a Darwin Core Archive — write_dwc
text: function transforms data : Occurrence core. Extended Measurement Facts extension meta.xml file. Key features Darwin Core transformation: Deployments (animal+ring associations) parent events, ringing resightings child events. information parent event provided ID, meaning data can expressed Occurrence core one row per observation parentEventID shared occurrences deployment. ringing event often contains metadata animal (sex, bird age). Bird age conservatively mapped lifeStage, pullus mapped juvenile. values mapped, life stage species-dependent. Sex bird age additionally provided Extended Measurement Facts extension, values mapped controlled vocabulary recommended OBIS. Observations without bird_id observation_status = "impossible" "unlikely" excluded. Parameters used set following record-level terms: dwc:datasetID: dataset_id. dwc:datasetName: dataset_name. dcterms:license: license. dcterms:rightsHolder: rights_holder.
